_comment: Fictional Northgate High School student in the shape of the MDR 'Ed-Fi v5' data model (entities as loaded in projects/lif_mdr_database/backup.sql) plus the real Ed-Fi Student identity elements StudentUniqueId / FirstName / MiddleName / LastSurname, which scripts/align-edfi-student-model.py adds to the published model (the seed has a single Student.Name string and a UniqueId, which Ed-Fi does not). Used by the schema-exchange demo to translate an Ed-Fi record into a college LIF model. Values exercise the EDUcore value crosswalk (GA -> Georgia) and the 3:1 initials rule in reference_data/samples/northgate-edfi-name-rules.json. One Course on purpose: the reference Ed-Fi rules map `Course.` to the Person root, so a multi-row Course makes JSONata emit a list-valued Person fragment and the translator's merge drops sibling fields (observed 2026-09-08).
